requirements.text: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling large-scale software systems serving high-traffic, production environments
* 12+ years of programming experience with demonstrated ability to solve complex, cross-system technical problems through direct implementation
* Experience leading multi-year technical roadmaps and cross-organizational engineering initiatives from vision through execution
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and functions through written proposals, architectural reviews, and stakeholder alignment
* Experience mentoring engineers across an organization and driving engineering culture improvements through programs, standards, and direct coaching
* Technical contributions to the privacy or security community (e.g., public research, blogging, presentations, industry standards work)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Experience operating in a governance, risk and compliance or second-line-of-defense function (controls design, assurance testing, or generating evidence for external audit or regulatory examination), including working directly with regulators, external auditors, or counsel on technical matters
* Experience interpreting regulatory, legal or control requirements and translating them into technical requirements, standards or automated enforcement
* Experience implementing or assessing the implementation of GDPR, CCPA, or equivalent privacy regulation at scale
* Privacy understanding, data strategy, or AI domain expertise
* Experience shipping products to many millions of customers

* Experience operating as the company-wide expert on a privacy domain, whether a product area or a problem area such as data deletion or retention, where engineers, Legal, Policy and senior leadership seek your guidance
* Experience designing frameworks, standards or assessment methodologies that were adopted by organizations beyond the one that built them
* Technical experience across other Privacy or Security disciplines, e.g., Application Security/Privacy, incident response, or adversarial testing
